findings.issue: אוֹתָם is the direct-object marker plus a 3mp suffix (them), not a dative. “a ellos” can stand as that tonic object, but the same “a” used for לַיהוָה can be read as a second recipient.

notes: Purpose, hiphil traer, qal sacrificar, plural faces, tienda de reunión, and both Jehová are licensed.
